title: Avoidance Strategy Planner
description: A digital tool that helps users create personalized avoidance strategies for harmful relationships, environments, or behaviors. It provides actionable steps, risk assessments, and progress tracking.
audience: Individuals seeking to avoid harmful relationships, environments, or behaviors; mental health advocates; life coaches.
pitch: The Avoidance Strategy Planner is a reusable digital product that empowers users to take control of their environment and behaviors. It offers a structured approach to identifying risks, setting goals, and tracking progress.
